title: Galax-z v11 quiet
description: Galax-z v11 without the tones when it is switched on.
notes: A seventh page on tracks 1-8, red, after the teal one: GROOVE. Keys are kept and played by one of TO-2's 69 grooves; on a melodic track a progression (133 of them) takes them through its chords.

Its dials: GROOVE, RATE, GATE, ORDER (chord, up, down, played, random). Hold SHIFT two seconds for the other four: PROGRESSION (all the way down: none), KEY, how long a chord lasts (half a bar to four), SWING. STOP on the page empties it; REC records it.
